index.page_intro: Helping foreigners in Korea move from connection to discipleship, leadership, and mission.
index.feed_title_text: Videos, posts, studies and events, with the newest first.
index.areas_title_text: Three ways to learn and grow. Start with whatever you need today.
index.paths_title_text: Pick the line that fits where you are. We'll show you each station.
index.academy_title_text: A structured path to develop people who can serve, lead, mentor and multiply ministry.
index.community_title_text: Groups meeting online and in person. Come as you are.
index.where_title: Where are you in your journey?
index.where_title_text: Choose the line that describes you today.

pathways.page_intro: Four lines, like a metro map. Choose the one that fits you, follow the stations in order, and mark each one as you finish it.

gospel.page_intro: Learn the Gospel and understand the message of salvation, at your own pace, with the Bible open.
gospel.topics_title_text: Search by topic, word or Bible book.
gospel.course_title_text: Six short lessons. Read the passages, think through the questions, and mark each lesson done.
gospel.studies_title_text: Guided studies for personal reading or a small group.
gospel.pc_title_text: Complete a course to earn a DHL certificate of completion.

discipleship.page_intro: Develop a deeper understanding of faith, the Bible, and Christian life, with a mentor and a group beside you.
discipleship.path_title_text: Seven steps, in order. Take each one with a mentor or small group, then mark it done.
discipleship.dtopics_title_text: Study these alone or with your group.
discipleship.pc_title_text: Complete a course to earn a DHL certificate of completion.

leadership.page_intro: Leadership at DHL means serving people well and helping them grow. Every course ends with a practical assignment.
leadership.lcourses_title_text: Study each topic, then complete the assignment with your mentor.

digital_ministry.page_intro: Your phone can be a ministry tool. Learn to create content, host online studies and build community online.
digital_ministry.dt_title_text: Practical skills for reaching and teaching people online.

academy.page_intro: A structured training pathway designed to develop people who can serve, lead, mentor, and multiply ministry.
academy.lvl_title_text: Each level builds on the one before. Your progress is shown on each step.
academy.courses_title_text: Mark courses done as you complete them. Level 5 is the practicum: real ministry, with supervision.
academy.rec_title_text: How someone is recognized and sent as a leader.

media.page_intro: Messages, Bible studies, testimonies and practical videos, newest first.
media.hub_title_text: We post on social media to meet people where they are, then invite them into real community.

community.page_intro: Nobody should face life in a new country alone. Find people, groups and mentors here.
community.chan_title_text: The easiest first step: say hello in one of our group chats.
community.groups_title_text: Online and in person. Ask to join and a leader will contact you.

events.page_intro: Bible studies, fellowship, training and camps. Everyone is welcome.

ai_assistant.page_intro: Ask a question and get an answer from DHL's resources, with sources you can check. For personal or difficult questions, talk to a mentor.
ai_assistant.src_title_text: DHL AI always tells you which source an answer comes from.

about.page_intro: Diaspora Hub for Leaders: from connection to commission.

contact.page_intro: Choose what fits you best. Every form goes to a real person on the DHL team.

contents.page_intro: Your learning hub for faith and life in Korea. Choose a category, continue where you left off, or search everything.
contents.eco_title_text: Every part of DHL supports one pathway, from first contact to multiplying leaders.

bible_journey.page_intro: A spiritual growth pathway from discovering the Gospel to becoming a disciple and growing as a leader.
bible_journey.bjp_title_text: Gospel, then Discipleship, then Leadership and Ministry. Mind Education runs alongside every step.
bible_journey.prog_title_text: Gospel Class and Discipleship Training follow the pathway. Mind Education supports you at every step.
bible_journey.bjm_title_text: Learn principles for a healthy and disciplined mind, good relationships, and a wise perspective on life. Mind Education isn't a single step on the pathway: it helps you grow at every stage, from your first question about the Gospel to leading others.
bible_journey.bjf_title_text: Complete the lessons and quiz to earn a DHL certificate of completion.
bible_journey.browse_title_text: From Beginner to Advanced. Search, or filter by program and level.

mind_education.page_intro: Learn principles for developing a healthy and disciplined mind, good relationships, and a wise perspective on life.
mind_education.ml_title_text: Eight lessons from Beginner to Advanced. Read the passages, think through the questions, and mark each one done.
mind_education.pc_title_text: Complete a course to earn a DHL certificate of completion.

live_in_korea.page_intro: A practical resource center for foreigners living, studying, or working in Korea.
live_in_korea.kp_title_text: Learn Korean, understand Korea, study or work, build relationships, and live well.
live_in_korea.ka_title_text: Jump to what you need today.
live_in_korea.kr_title_text: Trusted places for Filipinos and other foreigners in Korea.
live_in_korea.kf_title_text: Structured courses with a DHL certificate of completion.
live_in_korea.kg_title_text: Links go to official sites. Rules change, so always check the official source.
live_in_korea.qa_title_text: Questions about Korea, faith, education, work and daily life.

certificates.page_intro: Learn structured skills and complete recognized DHL courses. Study the lessons, pass the quiz, and receive a certificate of completion.
certificates.cat_title_text: Seven categories, from Beginner to Advanced.
certificates.hist_title_text: Saved in this browser. When DHL accounts are available, your history will move to your profile.

mentors.page_intro: Mentors walk with people one to one: listening, answering questions, studying the Bible together and helping with life in Korea. Choose someone and send them a message.
mentors.mentors_title_text: Choose a mentor and send them a message on KakaoTalk, Messenger or email.

lectures.page_intro: Videos, articles, slides and study materials from DHL. Choose a category to see all its lectures.
